title: Effective removal of antibiotics from aqueous solutions by a robust activated carbon: experimental and theoretical study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8875-8888
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05396J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Khan Badshah, Qaisar Ali, Rashid Ahmad, Iftikhar Ahmad
Activated carbon with an ultra-high surface area 3470 m2 g−1 is synthesized from coal, showing excellent adsorption capacities for moxifloxacin and linezolid. The DFT study demonstrated that hydrogen bonding is the dominant interaction.
